MALLET 0.30.1 preview - Mapping And Level Layout Editor Tool: a map editor for SurfsUp (and Counter-Strike: Source)
===================================================================================================================

START HERE
- Unzip the whole folder somewhere (keep MALLET.exe, MALLET.pck and the "materials" folder together) and
  double-click MALLET.exe. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" (the program isn't signed): click
  "More info", then "Run anyway".
- The guide: docs\GUIDE.html (or Help > The MALLET guide inside MALLET, or "New here? Read the guide" on the
  welcome screen). It takes you from an empty map to one your friends can play in ten minutes, then covers
  everything else: ramps, zones, build mode, materials, playing, testing with others and exporting.
- Everything new, version by version: docs\CHANGELOG.html (Help > What's new).

NEW IN 0.30.1 (SMOOTH CURVED RAMPS IN CS:S)
- Curved ramps exported to Counter-Strike: Source no longer stop you at the seams between their pieces. The CS:S
  export window also says which ramps CS:S can't texture (only the Material look carries over).

NEW IN 0.30.0 (CAMERA SHOTS AND VIDEOS)
- Make videos of your map without a screen recorder: View > Camera shots, fly the 3D view to a spot and press
  "Add key here", then the next spot... The camera glides smoothly through your keys (Play previews it). File >
  Render video makes an AVI (or PNG pictures; MP4 if you have ffmpeg) at exactly the size you pick, up to 4K.

NEW IN 0.29.1 (SKY FIXES)
- 2D sky shaders (shader_type canvas_item;) work as skies; a shader saved into your shaders folder shows up within
  a couple of seconds; each sky keeps its own settings; play mode hides the editor's ground grid.

WHAT WE'D LOVE YOU TO TEST
- Follow the guide's "A first map in ten minutes" from a blank map. Where did you get stuck?
- Make a material with the material maker and use it on a ramp, then export the map to SurfsUp and CS:S.
- Co-edit with a friend (guide section 8) and send a friend a test build.
- Anything that breaks, looks wrong or is confusing: tell whoever sent you MALLET what you did, what you expected
  and what happened.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Save with Ctrl+S; maps are .mallet files.
- File > Export > To SurfsUp needs SurfsUp installed; File > Export > To Counter-Strike: Source needs CS:S installed.
- F1 in build mode shows every key on screen.
